phrases.say: This is Family First-Week Lab, an independent concept I made for Lilli's Product Manager role.
phrases.cap:
Family First-Week Lab: an independent
concept for Lilli's Product Manager role

phrases.say: It isn't a Lilli product, and every household and number in it is made up.
phrases.cap:
It isn't a Lilli product, and every
household and number is made up

phrases.say: Lilli's family product is on a waiting list, so I designed this first week from public information only.
phrases.cap:
Lilli's family product is waitlisted,
so I worked from public pages only

phrases.say: I'll pick a fictional household: Grace, who is eighty one, and her son Daniel.
phrases.cap:
A fictional household: Grace, 81,
and her son Daniel

phrases.say: His goal is to feel reassured without calling every day.
phrases.cap:
His goal: feel reassured without
calling every day

phrases.say: This panel explains exactly what is simulated. The sensors match the kit on Lilli's public page.
phrases.cap:
This panel says what is simulated.
Sensors match Lilli's public kit

phrases.say: Consent comes first. Daniel sees what Grace will be asked about, one area at a time.
phrases.cap:
Consent comes first: Grace is asked
about each area, one at a time

phrases.say: Once he sends the invitation, it's pending. Nothing is collected, and he can't answer for her.
phrases.cap:
The invitation is pending. Nothing is
collected, and he can't answer for her

phrases.say: If he jumps ahead to Today, the app shows that it's waiting for consent, with no data.
phrases.cap:
Jumping ahead to Today shows
"Waiting for consent", with no data

phrases.say: Now I'm viewing as Grace. Nothing is ticked for her. She chooses what to share.
phrases.cap:
Now viewing as Grace. Nothing is
pre-ticked: she chooses

phrases.say: Each area comes with a plain description, so she knows exactly what it covers.
phrases.cap:
Each area has a plain description
of exactly what it covers

phrases.say: She shares five areas, and keeps her bathroom visits private.
phrases.cap:
She shares five areas and keeps
bathroom visits private

phrases.say: Daniel can see which areas she said yes to, and that she can change this at any time.
phrases.cap:
Daniel sees what she said yes to,
and that she can change it any time

phrases.say: If I reload the page, Grace's answer is still there. It's saved on the server, in a private session for this visitor, and the server is what enforces who can change it.
phrases.cap:
Reload: Grace's answer is still there,
saved and enforced on the server

phrases.say: The switch between Daniel and Grace is a demo role, not a sign-in, so it doesn't prove who agreed.
phrases.cap:
The role switch is a demo,
not a sign-in

phrases.say: Setup only counts the hub and the sensors Grace agreed to.
phrases.cap:
Setup counts only the hub and the
sensors Grace agreed to

phrases.say: A sensor that hasn't reported counts as missing, never as fine.
phrases.cap:
A silent sensor counts as missing,
never as fine

phrases.say: The first useful insight is about routine, not health.
phrases.cap:
The first useful insight is about
routine, not health

phrases.say: The kettle was first used around seven forty, with freshness and coverage alongside.
phrases.cap:
Kettle first used around 7:40, with
freshness and coverage alongside

phrases.say: It says how sure it is, and that sensors can't tell who used the kettle, or why.
phrases.cap:
It says how sure it is: sensors can't
tell who used the kettle, or why

phrases.say: Now a harder case. I'll switch the simulated week, so the hub went quiet thirty hours ago.
phrases.cap:
A harder case: the hub went quiet
30 hours ago (simulated)

phrases.say: Instead of looking calm, the app says it hasn't heard from the hub, and suggests a call or a message.
phrases.cap:
Instead of looking calm, it says so,
and suggests a call or a message

phrases.say: Now I'll switch to a different simulated week. Here, the routine looks different.
phrases.cap:
Another simulated week. Here,
the routine looks different

phrases.say: There were fewer front door opens and kettle uses in the last three days.
phrases.cap:
Fewer front-door opens and kettle
uses in the last three days

phrases.say: It doesn't guess why. It suggests a relaxed check in, and Daniel chooses how often he hears from it.
phrases.cap:
It doesn't guess why. It suggests
a relaxed check-in

phrases.say: A weekly digest is the default, and there are no instant alerts.
phrases.cap:
Weekly digest by default,
and no instant alerts

phrases.say: When coverage is patchy, it calls that a data gap, not a sign that nothing changed.
phrases.cap:
Patchy coverage is a data gap,
not a sign that nothing changed

phrases.say: Grace can stop sharing at any time.
phrases.cap:
Grace can stop sharing
at any time

phrases.say: When she does, Daniel's insights disappear, including earlier ones.
phrases.cap:
Then Daniel's insights disappear,
including earlier ones

phrases.say: Today now just says that sharing has been turned off.
phrases.cap:
Today now says sharing
has been turned off

phrases.say: Finally, the product lab: three hypotheses, two onboarding copy variants,
phrases.cap:
The product lab: hypotheses and
two onboarding copy variants

phrases.say: and a live event log with no names or raw sensor data.
phrases.cap:
A live event log, with no names
or raw sensor data

phrases.say: The funnel is a synthetic cohort, there to show the denominators. It isn't Lilli data, and it doesn't claim any lift.
phrases.cap:
The funnel is synthetic: not Lilli
data, and no lift is claimed

phrases.say: The PRD, metrics, experiments and test results are in the public repo. Independent concept by Ayo Ahmed.
phrases.cap:
PRD, metrics, experiments and tests
are in the repo. By Ayo Ahmed
